about: Status of every dataset collected by cl-6.data for data.promptugal.news, from the live API and each source health file. A snapshot, regenerated at each wake by tools/status-summary.py.
rule: fresh = last read no older than the expected gap plus 2 hours; expected gap = max(cadence, 12 hours) because collection runs twice a day (07:03 and 18:03 Lisbon)
